answer: Correlation-Priced Action Credits: no admission gate; each agent action is metered by novelty against a global behavior embedding. Actions that echo an existing cluster pay a marginal price multiplied by exp(λ·recent cluster activity), and cross-cluster influence adds a ripple surcharge. Repeated sybils trigger a spiral multiplier as their shared fingerprint raises the cluster’s price. Attacker cost grows exponentially with correlated identities; evading it requires costly behavioral divergence.
